scenes.hook: When you hear A I glasses, do you imagine a screen floating in front of your eyes? Not every pair has one.
scenes.idea: Glasses can combine microphones, speakers, cameras, and an assistant. The exact features depend on the model.
scenes.demo: An audio focused pair may answer through speakers without showing a visual interface in the lens.
scenes.compare: An augmented reality display is a separate capability. The labels A I and A R are not interchangeable.
scenes.takeaway: Before choosing, check the specific hardware, phone connection, available features, and recording indicators.
scenes.close: Would you prefer audio or a display? Subscribe to Tech at sixty for clear tech explainers.
